brief: The canvas displays a vast, dark cosmic expanse dominated by rich blues and purples, which convey the blurred sweep of the Milky Way. Scattered throughout this depth are countless individual points of light—the stars. These stars are not randomly twinkling, but instead pulse rhythmically and together in unison, creating a synchronized, breathing pattern across the sky. The colors shift slowly, giving the impression of immense cosmic distance and scale.
